## Purpose and Entry Points
Mixxx is a GPLv2 cross-platform desktop DJ application for live mixing on GNU/Linux, Windows, macOS, plus mobile-oriented packaging. The C++/Qt process begins at `src/main.cpp`, constructs application lifecycle/UI services in `src/mixxxapplication.cpp`, and coordinates long-lived subsystems through `src/coreservices.cpp`. CMake is the primary build composition boundary: `CMakeLists.txt`.

## Application, UI, and Control Model
Qt provides the desktop runtime; the application supports QML-based UI alongside legacy Qt widgets and XML skins. QML starts from `res/qml/main.qml` and reaches native services through proxy/model adapters in `src/qml/qmlcoreservices.cpp` and `src/qml/qmlcontrolproxy.cpp`. UI, scripts, and hardware do not directly manipulate DSP internals: they communicate through the shared observable control-object model in `src/control/controlobject.cpp` and `src/control/controlproxy.cpp`.

## Real-Time Audio Engine
The engine is the central real-time processing boundary. It composes deck, sampler, microphone, and auxiliary channels, applies gain/crossfader/effects, and produces routed audio buffers. Core orchestration and mixing reside in `src/engine/engine.h`, `src/engine/enginemixer.cpp`, and `src/engine/channelmixer.cpp`; channel implementations include `src/engine/channels/enginedeck.cpp`. Timing-sensitive playback controls (BPM, cueing, looping, rate, keylock) are engine-side objects under `src/engine/controls/`.

## Track Ingest, Playback, and Analysis
Files are decoded through pluggable sound sources, isolating codec/platform implementations from deck playback: `src/sources/soundsourceproviderregistry.cpp`, `src/sources/soundsourceffmpeg.cpp`, and `src/sources/soundsourcestem.cpp`. Read-ahead/caching bridges disk decoding and real-time consumption in `src/engine/cachingreader/cachingreader.cpp`. Background analysis schedules waveform, beat, gain/loudness, silence, and key extraction, persisting results for use by decks and visuals: `src/analyzer/trackanalysisscheduler.cpp`, `src/analyzer/analyzerthread.cpp`, `src/analyzer/analyzerwaveform.cpp`.

## Library and Persistent Metadata
The local music library is SQLite-backed, with schema management and DAOs separating persisted track/library state from Qt models and UI. Database ownership/migration is in `src/database/mixxxdb.cpp` and `src/database/schemamanager.cpp`; track and playlist persistence is represented by `src/library/dao/trackdao.cpp` and `src/library/trackcollection.cpp`. Scanner tasks import filesystem media into this model via `src/library/scanner/libraryscanner.cpp`. Metadata and cues/beat grids are represented by `src/track/track.cpp`, with TagLib-based metadata support under `src/track/taglib/`.

## Hardware, Timecode, and Scripting
Controller management enumerates MIDI/HID/bulk devices, loads mappings, and maps device events to controls. Primary boundaries are `src/controllers/controllermanager.cpp`, `src/controllers/midi/midicontroller.cpp`, and `src/controllers/hid/hidcontroller.cpp`. Mapping definitions and JavaScript controller scripts are shipped as resources under `res/controllers/`. Vinyl timecode is a specialized input path built around `src/vinylcontrol/vinylcontrolmanager.cpp` and vendored xwax code in `lib/xwax/timecoder.c`.

## Effects, Output, Recording, and Broadcast
Effects are modeled as chains/slots and instantiated through backend managers; built-in DSP, LV2, and macOS Audio Unit paths are isolated behind this boundary. See `src/effects/effectsmanager.cpp`, `src/effects/backends/effectsbackendmanager.cpp`, and `src/engine/effects/engineeffectsmanager.cpp`. The sound I/O layer selects platform backends such as PortAudio and PipeWire through `src/soundio/soundmanager.cpp` and `src/soundio/sounddevicepipewire.cpp`. Master output can be encoded for recording or network broadcast using `src/recording/recordingmanager.cpp`, `src/encoder/encoder.cpp`, and Icecast/Shout-compatible streaming support in `src/engine/sidechain/shoutconnection.cpp`.

## Rendering, Resources, and External Integration
Waveforms consume stored analysis plus live play position and render through Qt/OpenGL paths: `src/waveform/visualsmanager.cpp`, `src/waveform/waveformfactory.cpp`, and `src/rendergraph/opengl/engine.cpp`. Skins are loadable UI contracts, with QML and legacy implementations in `src/skin/qml/qmlskin.cpp` and `src/skin/legacy/legacyskin.cpp`. External metadata lookup is task-based over HTTP for MusicBrainz, AcoustID, and Cover Art Archive: `src/musicbrainz/tagfetcher.cpp` and `src/musicbrainz/web/acoustidlookuptask.cpp`. Key native dependencies include Qt, SQLite, FFmpeg, TagLib, PortAudio/PipeWire, Rubber Band, LV2, and optional platform audio APIs, discovered by `cmake/modules/`.
